from pathlib import Path
p=base/'programs'/f'{task}.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    base_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row))
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base_row]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            top = base_row - height
            out[top][c] = value
            for r in range(top + 1, base_row):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
